buyer_added_terms.text: OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses TERMS AND CONDITIONS FOR REPAIR AND REFURBISHMENT OF SHOPPING TROLLEYS 1. Replacement of Wheels. All four wheels of each shopping trolley shall be replaced with new, good-qualit y and durable wheels suitable for the intended use and smooth movement of the trolley. 2. Warranty of Wheels. The supplied wheels shall carry a minimum warranty of one year against manufact uring defects, premature wear and operational failures. 3. Welding and Fabrication Work. All necessary welding, fabrication, alignment and associated repair work s shall be undertaken by the firm. This shall specifically include welding and rectification of all broken, crac ked, damaged or detached parts of the shopping trolley to restore its original strength and functionality. 4. Surface Treatment and Colouring. The firm shall carry out necessary surface treatment, polishing and a ppropriate coating/painting/colouring of the2. Warranty of Wheels. The supplied wheels shall carry a mini mum warranty of one year against manufacturing defects, premature wear and operational failures. 5. Accessories and Fittings. All accessories and fittings required for installation of the wheels, including bolt s, nuts, washers, brackets and other necessary hardware, shall be included in the quoted cost. No addition al payment shall be admissible for these items. 6. Sample Submission and Approval. The firm shall repair and refurbish one sample shopping trolley, incor porating all the stipulated requirements, and submit the same at Alwar for inspection and approval by the competent authority. The firm shall undertake bulk repair work only after obtaining approval of the sample. stainless steel (SS) parts of the shopping trolley, wherever required, to ensure a neat, uniform and refurbis hed appearance.7. Place of Execution of Work. The complete repair and refurbishment work of all shoppin g trolleys shall be carried out at Rewari, as the shopping trolleys are presently held at Rewari. The firm sha ll make necessary arrangements for execution of the work at the designated location. 8. One-Year Comprehensive Warranty. The firm shall provide a comprehensive warranty of one year from t he date of completion and acceptance of the work. The warranty shall cover all replaced wheels, fittings, w elding, fabrication, surface treatment and other repair works undertaken by the firm. 9. Free Repair and Replacement During Warranty. Any defect, malfunction or damage arising during the w arranty period under normal operating conditions, including failure of wheels, fittings, welding or fabricatio n work, shall be rectified by the firm free of cost. Any defective component shall be repaired or replaced w ithout additional charges, including labour and material costs. 10. Quality of Workmanship. The firm shall ensure proper fitting, alignment, stability, durability and smoot h movement of all shopping trolleys after completion of the repair work. All repaired trolleys shall be hand ed over in fully functional and satisfactory condition. 11. Completion of Work. The firm shall complete the repair and refurbishment work within the stipulated ti me as agreed upon with the ordering authority. 12. Final Inspection and Acceptance. The completed repair and refurbishment work shall be subject to insp ection by the authorised representative. Payment shall be processed only after satisfactory completion an d acceptance of the work. .
